### Misc families: dayz, armareforger, sandstorm, ets2, ats, fivem (branch `feature/game-config-misc`, 2026-10-02)

None of these has been applied to a REAL server by this change: every row is `built` (fake-guest tests in `test/cfg-<family>.test.ts` only).

| Family | Field | Mechanism | When | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| armareforger | SERVER_NAME, SERVER_PASSWORD, MAX_PLAYERS, SCENARIO_ID, BATTLEYE, ADMINS, VISIBLE, RCON_PASSWORD | env-recreate (`env-family.ts` factory): each schema key IS the image's env var; ADMIN_PASSWORD (minted, not a field) is carried over. Reinstall: baked by `applyGameConfigEnv` | recreate | built |
| ets2, ats | lobby_name, description, welcome_message, password, max_players, player_damage, traffic, force_speed_limiter, name_tags, server_logon_token, moderator_list | env-recreate of `ETS_SERVER_*` / `ATS_SERVER_*`. The image regenerates `server_config.sii` from env on EVERY start (`ETS_SERVER_WRITE_CONFIG` defaults true), so env is the only mechanism. Text fields reject `"` and `\` (written unescaped between quotes). Reinstall: baked by `applyGameConfigEnv` | recreate | built |
| sandstorm | serverName | env `HOSTNAME` (the entrypoint passes `-hostname="$HOSTNAME"`). Schema got `envKey: HOSTNAME` so a fresh install bakes it (it never did before) | recreate | built |
| sandstorm | mapScenario, password, maxPlayers | ONE env var `LAUNCH_SERVER_ENV` = travel URL `Map?Scenario=..?Game=..?password=..?MaxPlayers=..` + launch args; existing `-args` (mods, mutators) are preserved. Baked at install by `applySandstormSetup` (new `-e LAUNCH_SERVER_ENV`) | recreate | built |
| dayz | hostname, password, passwordAdmin, maxPlayers, missionTemplate | config-file patch of `/opt/dayz/serverfiles/saves/serverDZ.cfg` (the `-config=` the ich777 start script uses); value-only edits, comments kept; read back and verified, rolled back on failure | restart | built |
| fivem | all | UNCHANGED: still the inline `applyFivem` in `worker/fivem.ts`, family still feature-flagged and not in `REAL_APPLY_FAMILIES`. Legally sensitive (no managed FiveM sale without owner permission): informational/flagged only, nothing enabled | n/a | untouched |

Facts and traps found (read off the image scripts and docs, not a live server):
- **Kit change.** `recreateWithEnv` now carries the container's `--stop-timeout` (arma and ETS/ATS ship `--stop-timeout 30`; a recreate used to drop it to docker's 10s). Sandstorm/Arma/ETS recreate `docker create` flags otherwise unchanged.
- **DayZ path.** The inline applier looked first at `serverfiles/dayz/saves/serverDZ.cfg`, which does not exist on the ich777 image. The real file is `serverfiles/saves/serverDZ.cfg`, created on the FIRST start by copying Bohemia's template and seeding `hostname "Docker DayZ"`, `password "Docker"`, `passwordAdmin "adminDocker"`. Consequences: (1) before first start there is no file, so the applier reports "saved, not applied yet, start the server then save again"; (2) a fresh or reinstalled DayZ server runs with join password `Docker` and admin password `adminDocker` until the customer saves Settings after it first boots. The inline `applyDayZ` was removed; `updateDayZConfig` stays (exported, own tests). DayZ is orderable only once a Steam account exists (`lib/dayz-steam.ts`).
- **ETS2/ATS reinstall was broken.** Their setup script quotes the volume (`-v "/opt/ets2:/home/steam/.local/share/Euro Truck Simulator 2"`), so `dockerHostMountsFrom` captured `"/opt/ets2`, rejected it as unsafe, and `gameReinstall` refused to run ("refusing to wipe blind"). Regex now allows an optional leading quote.
- **Sandstorm** `LAUNCH_SERVER_ENV` is word-split, so the map string and password may not contain whitespace (schema patterns enforce it); the password also may not contain `?`.
- Sandstorm's template shipped NO `LAUNCH_SERVER_ENV`, so map/password/max-players from checkout were never applied. Fresh installs now get the composed default (`...?MaxPlayers=10`, matching the schema default).
EOF

input.message:
Report from `misc`: dayz, armareforger, sandstorm, ets2 and ats now have appliers. FiveM is untouched. `tsc --noEmit` shows 0 errors, and 103 tests pass across my 4 new test files plus `game-config-appliers`, `terraria-applier`, `dayz-*` and `game-presets`.

**No real server apply was run for any family.** Everything is covered by fake-guest tests only.

Branch `feature/game-config-misc`, worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-cfg-misc`, one commit `af7eceba1f` on top of `feature/game-config-apply-core`. Notes are in `/root/agent-notes/cfg-misc.md`. Per-field table and findings are in `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` under "Misc families".

## Per family

**armareforger**
- All 8 schema fields are `recreate`: SERVER_NAME, SERVER_PASSWORD (secret), MAX_PLAYERS, SCENARIO_ID, BATTLEYE, ADMINS, VISIBLE, RCON_PASSWORD (secret).
- Mechanism: recreate the container with new env. Each schema key is a documented env var of the image.
- The minted ADMIN_PASSWORD is carried over untouched.
- Reinstall is already covered by `applyGameConfigEnv`; a test checks it.

**ets2 and ats**
- All 11 fields are `recreate`.
- Mechanism: recreate with `ETS_SERVER_*` / `ATS_SERVER_*` env. The image rewrites `server_config.sii` from env on every start (I read its entrypoint), so env is the only mechanism.
- The image writes text values between double quotes with no escaping. I added schema patterns rejecting `"` and `\` in text fields, a digits-and-commas pattern on the moderator list, and an alphanumeric pattern on the logon token. The applier refuses these values too.
- Reinstall is covered by `applyGameConfigEnv`.

**sandstorm**
- All 4 fields are `recreate`.
- serverName maps to `HOSTNAME`.
- mapScenario, password and maxPlayers compose into one `LAUNCH_SERVER_ENV`: `Map?Scenario=..?Game=..?password=..?MaxPlayers=..`, plus launch args. Any mod or mutator args already in the variable are preserved.
- I added schema patterns on mapScenario and password (no whitespace, and no `?` in the password) because the variable is word-split.
- Before this, none of these four fields was applied. The template had no `LAUNCH_SERVER_ENV`, and serverName had no `envKey`. I added `envKey: HOSTNAME` and `applySandstormSetup`, so fresh installs and reinstalls now bake all four.
- Fresh installs now start with the composed default, which ends in `?MaxPlayers=10`.

**dayz**
- All 5 fields are `restart`.
- Mechanism: patch `/opt/dayz/serverfiles/saves/serverDZ.cfg` (only the values, comments kept, read back and verified, rolled back on failure).
- The old inline `applyDayZ` was removed. It looked in a `dayz/saves/` path that doesn't exist on the ich777 image.
- The cfg doesn't exist until the server's first start. Until then the applier returns ok with a note saying "saved, not applied; start the server then save again".
- `dayz` is now in `REAL_APPLY_FAMILIES` through `APPLIER_SPECS`. The old comment said to add it only after live verification. This has not been live-verified (no Steam account exists to boot one), so say if you want it kept out.

**fivem**
- Left exactly as it was: inline `applyFivem`, still feature-flagged, not in `REAL_APPLY_FAMILIES`, nothing enabled. Documented as informational only.

## Things found that you should know
- **DayZ default passwords.** The ich777 image seeds `password "Docker"` and `passwordAdmin "adminDocker"` on first boot. A fresh or reinstalled DayZ server runs with those until the customer saves Settings after it first starts. I could not bake the settings at install because the file only exists after first start. Decision for you: a first-boot hook, or a gate so DayZ isn't sold until that's handled. DayZ can't be ordered yet anyway, since the Steam account is missing.
- **ets2/ats reinstall was broken.** Their quoted `-v "/opt/ets2:..."` mount made `dockerHostMountsFrom` reject the path, so `gameReinstall` refused to run ("refusing to wipe blind"). I fixed the regex.
- **Recreate kit change.** The recreate kit used to drop `--stop-timeout 30` (arma, ets2 and ats ship it) back to docker's default. It now carries it. That path has no test, because the fake guest doesn't model the field.

## What I could not verify
- Any real container, config file or game. In particular:
  - the DayZ file path and first-boot behaviour, read from the image scripts only;
  - that Sandstorm honours `?MaxPlayers=` and `?password=` in the travel URL, taken from the image README example;
  - that the arma and convoy images pick up the recreated env, taken from their docs and entrypoint.
- The Sandstorm and DayZ image sources were fetched by curl, not WebFetch; the arma README came via WebFetch.

## Files touched
- **New:** `lib/game-applier-specs/{dayz,armareforger,sandstorm,convoy,ets2,ats}.ts`, `worker/game-config-appliers/{dayz,armareforger,sandstorm,ets2,ats,env-family}.ts`, `test/cfg-{dayz,armareforger,sandstorm,ets2}.test.ts` (the ets2 file also covers ats), `test/_cfg-misc-helpers.ts`.
- **Shared files:**
  - `lib/game-config-appliers.ts`: 5 imports and 5 `APPLIER_SPECS` lines.
  - `worker/game-config-appliers/index.ts`: 5 imports and 5 `register` lines.
  - `worker/game-config.ts`:
    - removed the `case "dayz"` line;
    - deleted `applyDayZ` and the `DAYZ_CONTAINER` const, leaving a short comment;
    - kept `updateDayZConfig`.
  - `worker/game-variant.ts` (merge conflict likely, since other agents will chain onto the same line):
    - 1 import;
    - a `scriptWithSandstorm` block after the Terraria block;
    - the `scriptWithPin` line now reads `scriptWithSandstorm`;
    - the `dockerHostMountsFrom` regex gained an optional leading quote.
  - `worker/game-config-appliers/kit/env-recreate.ts`: `stopTimeout` field, parsed and passed as `--stop-timeout`.
  - `lib/game-config.ts`:
    - sandstorm: `envKey` on serverName, patterns, help text;
    - ets2 and ats: patterns on the text fields;
    - dayz: patterns on hostname, password and passwordAdmin, plus corrected comments and the `REAL_APPLY_FAMILIES` comment.
  - `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`: one appended subsection at the end. I left the existing "(next family)" row alone to avoid conflicts.
